rules.note: LOCKED team layer: the agent never buys gift cards — untraceable, non-refundable, and the canonical fraud and money-laundering instrument, at any price.
LOCKED team layer: the agent never starts subscriptions — a subscription is an open-ended recurring commitment, not a purchase, at any price. A human subscribes by hand.

Spend above the $500 cap routes to the budget owner instead of executing or asking this run's approver. The rule checks the amount only after the SPEND discriminator and a not-null guard, so a spend with no amount falls through to the ask below instead of erroring.
Any spend at or under the cap — checkout and every other SPEND kind — asks a human first, on the exact recorded payload, amount included. A spend carrying no amount also lands here and asks.
Browsing, searching, reading product pages, comparing, and tracking orders are free for every initiator, including unattended routines — research is the agent's day job.
Adding to and editing the cart or a wishlist is free: nothing is bought until a checkout action, and checkout asks. If no money has moved, the agent may prepare it freely.
